title: Best gift to suprise relatives
text:
Best gift to suprise relatives. Gifted this to my brother this Christmas. Both he and his daughter loved it so much, they immediately washed it out to use for their Christmas dinner. His wife and son weren't entirely sure what to think about their new gravy boat. lol

I did open the parcel upon receiving to ensure it was not broken before gift wrapping. It came well packed in sytrofoam, very secure, everything perfect. Greatly appreciate the holiday enthusiasm over the gift!

product_metadata.title: Puking Kitty Gravy Boat (Black Creamer 3oz)
description: The Kitten Creamer is just like the Puking Kitty Gravy Boat, just smaller and cuter! Pair them together to make a happy little family.
